notes.title: Update v2.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Scorpion Broken Armor Particle Review[/b]

The broken armor particles look better in terms of volume.


[*][b]Heragos Cloth Physics Improvement[/b]

Cloth physics is improved. It looks less stiffer and most of the issues with the collisions have been solved.


[*][b]Bandit AI Overall Improvement[/b]

Bandits used to fight individually when they noticed Heragos, and the other bandits might not have been aware of an intruder. Now, when any single bandit notices Heragos, he calls all the other bandits in the area and they fight as a group. Some bugs have been fixed.

[*][b]Dynamic Cam Improvement[/b]

Dynamic camera angles have been revisited in order to point the character to the correct path in a better way.


[*][b]Pyramid Games Intro[/b]

Pyramid Games' intro video has been added to the game.

[*][b]Market Cross Button Fix[/b]

Players couldn't see the cross button in the market system and they used to attempt exiting the menu by pressing the "Esc" button. Now the cross button has a better visibility.

[*][b]Door SFX Attenuation[/b]

The opening door SFX has an attenuation now. Players can know where they should go when they're inside the camp.

[/list]

notes.title: Update v2.0.1
notes.content:
[b]~Huge Updates~[/b]

[list]

[*][b]Market/Clothing System and Dialogue:[/b] A fully new market system has been added to the game. Heragos now can buy clothes, weapons, and shields.

[*][b]"Sandstorm" Level Composition Improvement:[/b] The timings of the conversations have been  re-adjusted. The story became more flowing.

[*][b]Level Design:[/b] Level design has been improved overall. There are more content in the map that the players can interact with. Also, the quality and the interpolation of various actors and elements have been modified in a way that serves more natural.

[*][b]AI Hit Animations:[/b] Hit animations added to enemies that plays when enemies get damage.

[*][b]Sword Trail Particles:[/b] Different types of sword trails play Heragos attacks.


[*][b]Scorpion Tail Particle:[/b] To indicate that Heragos has been attacked, A particle on scorpions' tails play when they swing their tail.

[*][b]"Discovered" System:[/b] New locations that Heragos discovers show up on screen as a notification.

[*][b]AI Disintegration VFX:[/b] Old sand particles removed from the game and they're replaced with a totally new disintegration VFX and Particle.

[*][b]Sprint Mode:[/b] Sprint mode added  to the game. Players can now use it to discover the map faster. In combat, Heragos can now run away from the enemies and regenerate if his health is too low. Speed mode uses stamina.

[*][b]Beetle Stat Improvement System:[/b] From now on, players are able to improve Heragos' sub-stats in the inventory screen by spending beetles.

[*][b]Beetle Chest:[/b] A source of beetles. When Heragos opens one, he gets large amount of beetles.

[*][b]Beetle Nest:[/b] A source of beetles. When Heragos digs up one, he gets small amount of beetles.

[*][b]Clot Worms:[/b] A source of beetles. When heragos slashes one, he gets rare amount of beetles. Not every clot worm provides beetles.


[/list]

[b]~Improvements and Fixes~[/b]

[list]

[*][b]Rock Textures Remaster:[/b] Most of the rocks now have 16x higher texture resolution. This improves the visualization in the environment.

[*][b]Note System Update:[/b] Note system is revisited and completed. The note that Heragos finds makes more sense now.

[*][b]River Visual Defects Fix:[/b] LODs caused visual defects in the earlier versions. Fixed in the new version.

[*][b]Sacred Rocks' Particles Visibility Fix:[/b] In most of the graphics settings such as low, medium, and high, players could not see the particle spawned on Sacred Rocks. Fixed.

[*][b]Bandit Sounds:[/b] Bandit sounds added. Now they scream when they attack and get damage.

[*][b]Bandit AI Revision:[/b] Artifical Intelligence of bandits has been improved. Their movements became more fluent and they started acting as a group. There's a simple communication goes between them.

[*][b]Vase Accessibility Improvement:[/b] Vases will start shining after a certain distance to indicate that they are destructible.

[*][b]New Blood Particle:[/b] Old blood particles have been removed and they're replaced with new ones that look more realistic.

[*][b]New Spider Hit and Armor Breaking Sounds:[/b] When spiders' and scorpions' armors break, there's a sound effect that indicates it.

[*][b]Sandstorm Optimization:[/b] The particles on sandstorm were replaced with a shader based meshed.

[*][b]Special Attack Charge Sounds:[/b] Each special attack slot plays a unique sound effect once the attacks get charged.

[*][b]Dynamic Camera Improvements:[/b] Dynamic Camera in some areas got improved to present a better view to players.

[*][b]Collision Fixes:[/b] AI's and objects' collisions improved and bugs fixed.

[*][b]Scorpion Armor Breaking Particle Remaster:[/b] Scorpion armor particles are remastered. Now, they shatter in more realsitic shapes.

[*][b]New Spider and Bug Hit and Death Sound Effects:[/b] Hit and death sounds are added to scorpions and spiders.

[*][b]Improvements on Gameplay and Story Elements:[/b] 

[*][b]Improved Ladder Climbing Locomotion:[/b] There used to be a motion related issue in the climbing system. The issue has been fixed in the most recent version.

[*][b]Multilangual Text Improvements:[/b] Some texts in the game have been improved for better understanding.

[*][b]Synchronization Fix Between Consecutive Levels:[/b] Loading time and procedure in the older versions had serious issues, which we have fixed.

[*][b]Main Menu, Settings, and UI Fixes:[/b] There used to be bugs and visual issues in the main menu, in-game UIs and UI based systems. Scrolling between potions used to cause the potion icon on the top right corner to be invisible. Enabling the "Pause Game" menu inside the inventory and other actors used to cause the mouse cursor to become invisible. All of these issues have been fixed.

[*][b]Minimap Stutter Fix:[/b] Instantaneous rotation problem in the minimap has been fixed.

[*][b]Dynamic Camera Fixes on Market and Weapon Honing Systems:[/b] The camera system was buggy when we first linked it with other two systems. Now it works without any issues.

[*][b]Resolution and Scability Bug Fixes:[/b] Graphics settings in the main menu had several issues such as starting the game in a wrong resolution or "0x0" resolution setting. The issues have been fixed.

[*][b]Weapon Pivot Fixes:[/b] The weapons were placed incorrectly in Heragos' hand due to their pivots. Their rotations have been fixed.

[*][b]Gameplay and Bug Fixes:[/b] Except the ones listed above, there are many bug fixes and improvements in the game and more to come in the future.

[/list]

Thanks for reading this announcement. We are a two-people team, and as always, we're doing our best to present "Lands of Pharaoh: Episode 1" to you in the best way we can. There are countless improvements, systems, and fixes we will be uploading in the next few months. Stay tuned.

Pyramid Games

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Major Update:[/b] Sandstorm Map
An entirely new level has been added to the game.
[*][b]Armor System[/b]
Heragos' armor used to stay at a certain value. Now, it also has a dynamic value and can be breakable. When the armor breaks there is a sound effect that plays, Heragos starts to receive vital damages, and can be recharged with certain potions.
[*][b]Health and Armor Bars[/b]
The two bars used to work with a code-based UI. They're replaced with a material based bars. The transitions when Heragos loses health and armor look way more smoother and more organic.
[*][b]UI[/b]
Updated user and AI user interfaces with a new design. Most of the huds on screen either removed or scaled down to keep the overall view less distracting.
[*][b]AI[/b]
Improved AIs and fixed several bugs related to animation and the presence of enemies. Human AIs particle effects have been enhanced.
[*][b]Enemy AI Armor Sound Effect[/b]
The sound effect when Heragos attacks an enemy that owns armor is different than the ones that do not own one.
[*][b]Tutorials[/b]
Utilizing many gamers' reviews and comments, we have added new in-game tutorials, which will help them tune themselves into the mechanics of the game and recognize the locations of quests.
[*][b]Explosive Boxes[/b]
Explosive boxes have been added to the game. These boxes affect combat mechanics vastly since they're timed boxes after a certain point and can damage Heragos, AIs, and other explosive boxes.
[*][b]Chest[/b]
The camera angle changes during interactions with chests.
[*][b]Minimap[/b]
Minimap color changes when between day and night.
[*][b]Inventory[/b]
Recapped the inventory system. Added definitions to items collected from environment.
[*][b]Potions[/b]
Heragos can no longer consume potions if his stats related to those potions are at their maximum values.
[*][b]Light Attack[/b]
Decreased the damage value of light attack to enhance the importance of other attack types.
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Dozens of bugs regarding gameplay and mechanics were identified and fixed. Gameplay became more stable overall.
[/list]
